blocks.text: Watch a real business built from zero, no scripts, no shortcuts, no prior setup. Month by month, live.
Every month inside the 2026 Challenge, you get access to a recorded live build session where Khalid builds a real online business from scratch, in real time, with real money on the line.

No pre-built assets. No pretend scenarios. You watch the market research, the offer creation, the traffic strategy, and the first sales, all live. You then apply the same framework to your own business.
The exact process used to start, build, and scale
Frameworks you apply directly to your own business
Monthly tasks ensure you don't just watch, you build
